name: design
description: This skill should be used when the user has a workflow's requirements and wants to plan how AI will do the work: which parts are skills or agents, how much the AI decides at each step, where a person checks, what it connects to, and how each part will be checked. It writes a plan the Build step follows, task by task, and asks the user only what only they can decide. Also use when the user says "continue my workflow" and the workflow needs its plan, a plan was stopped partway, or Build sent back a question; and when the user says "change my workflow" to change one that's planned, built or live. This is the Design step of the AI Workflow Framework.
